text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Great work, Trainer. We've truly become an 
unbeatable team!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've prepared a slightly lavish 
gift for a team like that.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I have high hopes for your future 
endeavors. Do your best, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Tazuna's special refreshments brought the 
team closer together, firing up everyone's 
motivation for the Aoharu Cup!"
